name: Usami Hana
source:
A nursery teacher who is married to her ex-classmate. She is very kind but also has a more "mature" side to her.
Her husband's sperm isn't fertile for some reason, and as such she cannot have children with him - because she is loyal to him, Hana feels guilty for cheating on him.
